name: radha_pump_is_fixed_when_the_ability_resolves
notes: Printed: '{4}{R}{G}: Radha gets +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the number of lands you control.' The ability resolves with two lands in play: X = 2 and Radha is 5/5. A third land played afterwards (the Forest from the hand) does not make her bigger: an effect of a resolved ability uses the number it found as it resolved (CR 611.2c).
